description: PT4Opt-LLM prompt history blocks for Option 2 Stage 1. Applied to ptllm and ptllm_tpe (hybrid fixed at H0 unless noted). history_window defaults to 20 for all.

variants.label: baseline
variants.notes: Current production defaults.

variants.label: top5_worst5_summary
variants.notes: User proposal: best/worst only plus run-level summary.

variants.label: top5_worst5
variants.notes: Ablate summary vs P1.

variants.label: top5_worst5_recent5_summary
variants.notes: User proposal: short recency tail.

variants.label: top10_worst5_summary
variants.notes: User proposal: more best trials, no recency block.

variants.label: top5_worst5_recent10_summary
variants.notes: P1 plus full recent-10 block.

variants.label: top5_worst5_recent10
variants.notes: P2 plus recent-10; tests recency without summary.

variants.label: top10_worst5_recent10_summary
variants.notes: P4 plus recent-10 (richest fixed recipe).

variants.label: baseline_recent10_summary
variants.notes: P0 counts + summary only.

variants.label: top10_worst5_recent5_summary
variants.notes: Many best + medium recency.

variants.label: top8_worst5_recent10_summary
variants.notes: Balanced high-signal context.

variants.label: top5_worst4_recent10_summary
variants.notes: Tighter worst pool (baseline worst_k) + recent10.

variants.label: top6_worst5_recent10_summary
variants.notes: Near-baseline top_k with symmetric worst5.

variants.label: top10_worst4_recent10_summary
variants.notes: Wide best + baseline worst + recent10.

variants.label: top5_worst5_recent5
variants.notes: Ablate summary vs P3.

variants.label: top6_worst4_recent10
variants.notes: P0 without summary (summary ablation on baseline shape).

variants.label: tcs_p5_h2
variants.notes: Paper-faithful TCS + Analysis Agent (gpt-4o-mini); P5 history settings + H2 hybrid.

variants.label: tcs_single_agent
variants.notes: TCS + 6-part analysis + JSON in one LLM call (ablation vs P16 two-call split).

variants.label: p5_budget_context
variants.notes: P5 + run budget and stagnation context (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_explore_refine
variants.notes: P5 with explore/refine phase replacing numeric HP trends (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_best_so_far
variants.notes: P5 + best-so-far improvement trajectory (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_hp_marginals
variants.notes: P5 + per-hyperparameter marginal stats (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_source_tags
variants.notes: P5 + llm/tpe source tags on history lines (ptllm_tpe/H2 ablation).

variants.label: p5_tuning_playbook
variants.notes: P5 + Google tuning playbook principles in system prompt (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_coverage_map
variants.notes: P5 + search-space coverage map (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_rationale_diversity
variants.notes: P5 + last LLM rationale outcome and diversity warning (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p5_tpe_hint
variants.notes: P5 + TPE peek hint on LLM turns (ptllm_tpe P5/H2 ablation).

variants.label: p22_playbook_run_context
variants.notes: P22 + trial position and playbook-aligned action hints per run (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p22_coverage_map
variants.notes: P22 + search-space coverage map (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p22_best_so_far
variants.notes: P22 + best-so-far improvement trajectory (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: p22_full_context
variants.notes: P22 + playbook run context + coverage map (ptllm ablation).

variants.label: P5+
variants.notes: P5 + self-run experience (cohort top/worst min-max; may overlap). A1 baseline.

variants.label: P5+_A2_cohort_nonoverlap
variants.notes: A2: cohort ranges with neither-dead-zone non-overlap (prefer∩avoid claimed by neither).

variants.label: P5+_A5_marginal_nonoverlap
variants.notes: A5: marginal per-HP bins for prefer/avoid; bins exclusive; neither on envelope overlap.

variants.label: P5+_A6_marginal_diff
variants.notes: A6: prefer from marginal bins; avoid from nearest-good-diff blamed HPs; neither non-overlap.

variants.label: P5+_A1_trial50
variants.notes: P5+ A1 cohort; experience_self block from trial 50 only (trials 1-49 = plain P5).

variants.label: P5+_A2_trial50
variants.notes: P5+ A2 cohort+neither; experience_self from trial 50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50
variants.notes: P5+ A5 marginal+neither; experience_self from trial 50.

variants.label: P5+_A6_trial50
variants.notes: P5+ A6 marginal+diff; experience_self from trial 50.

variants.label: P5+_A2_trial50_explore_exploit_50
variants.notes: A2 T50 + 50/50: exploit=experience_self(A2) OR explore=coverage_map (never both).

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50_explore_exploit_50
variants.notes: A5 T50 + 50/50: exploit=experience_self(A5) OR explore=coverage_map (never both).

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50_explore_exploit_50_histgate
variants.notes: A5 T50 X50 + conservative cat history gate (n>=5, delta>=0.03, prefer in top 25% and avoid not in top) and log-space numeric bins. New eval id so it does not overwrite P5plusA5T50X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50_explore_exploit_50_logbins
variants.notes: A5 T50 X50 + log-space numeric bins only (legacy cat, no 15% numeric gate).

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50_explore_exploit_50_cat_neither
variants.notes: A5 T50 X50 + cat-neither history gate (n>=3, delta>=0.02, prefer in top 25%; avoid only if not in top, else prefer-only).

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial50_explore_exploit_50_retrieve
variants.notes: X50 + cross-task experience retrieval (role-importance + Spearman rerank after 24 local trials, top-3). Bank is experience_bank_v2.jsonl with frozen weights. Does not overwrite P5plusA5T50X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_cascade_holdout
variants.notes: X50 + cascade similar-task on every LLM turn. Eval 30 datasets held out of the bank. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_surrogate_holdout
variants.notes: X50 + per-algo GP landscape similar-task on every LLM turn. Eval 30 datasets held out. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_surrogate_until_self
variants.notes: RS retrieve only until trial 50 (P5+ this-run start). Warm-start similar tasks, then this-run prefer/avoid takes over. Does not overwrite RS.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_surrogate_stop10
variants.notes: RS surrogate retrieve for trials 1-10 only (stop_trial=11). Same T50/X50 as shipping HPUCB_arm. Pair with HPUCB_arm decay sweep. Does not overwrite RSWarm.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop10
variants.notes: RS10 retry with full landscape cache (eval targets scored from trial 1). New id so it does not overwrite P5plusA5T50X50RS10.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop3
variants.notes: RS3: landscape retrieve for trials 1-3 only (stop_trial=4). Same T50/X50 + HPUCB_arm 90→10. Does not overwrite RS10gp.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop10_floor05
variants.notes: RS10 landscape, GP sim floor 0.5. Does not overwrite RS10gp.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop3_floor05
variants.notes: RS3 landscape, GP sim floor 0.5. Does not overwrite RS3.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop5_floor05
variants.notes: RS5 landscape (trials 1-5, stop_trial=6), GP sim floor 0.5. Does not overwrite RS5f03.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop10_floor03
variants.notes: RS10 landscape, GP sim floor 0.3. Does not overwrite RS10gp/RS10f05.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop5_floor03
variants.notes: RS5 landscape (trials 1-5, stop_trial=6), GP sim floor 0.3.

variants.label: P5+_similar_surrogate_holdout_v3
variants.notes: GRPO collect: P5 + v3 fANOVA cards + landscape GP from trial 1. Mix schedule uses this at prefixes k=3,10 (rs_warm). Empty k allowed. Does not overwrite P5plusA5T50X50RS / RS10gp eval ids.

variants.label: P5+_similar_surrogate_holdout_v4_top3bottom3
variants.notes: v4 RS cards: v3 fANOVA prefer lines plus top-3 and bottom-3 trial configs. Mix schedule rs_warm at k=3,10 when --rs-version v4.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop3_floor05_v4
variants.notes: RS3f05 + v4 top-3/bottom-3 configs (v3 bank). Trials 1-3. Does not overwrite RS3f05.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop5_floor05_v4
variants.notes: RS5 + v4 top-3/bottom-3, GP sim floor 0.5, trials 1-5 (stop_trial=6). Does not overwrite RS5f03.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop10_floor05_v4
variants.notes: RS10 + v4 top-3/bottom-3, GP sim floor 0.5, trials 1-10 (stop_trial=11). Does not overwrite RS10f05.

variants.label: P5+_similar_surrogate_holdout_v5_quantile20_tb3
variants.notes: v5 RS cards: 3-segment HP ranges (exclusive top / mixed overlap / exclusive bottom) plus grouped top3/bottom3 configs. Mix schedule rs_warm at k=3,10 when --rs-version v5.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop3_floor05_v5_q20
variants.notes: RS3f05 + v5: exclusive top / mixed / exclusive bottom 20% ranges plus top3/bottom3 configs. Trials 1-3.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop5_floor05_v5_q20
variants.notes: RS5 window + v5 quantile20 + top3/bottom3. Trials 1-5.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_X50_landscape_stop10_floor05_v5_q20
variants.notes: RS10 window + v5 quantile20 + top3/bottom3. Trials 1-10.

variants.label: P5+_A5_exploit_force
variants.notes: GRPO collect: A5 self-run regions on every LLM turn (no retrieve, no coverage). Mix schedule uses this at prefixes k=60,80. start_trial=1 so those prefixes include the block.

variants.label: P5+_A5_explore_force
variants.notes: GRPO collect: coverage_map only (XOR explore). Mix schedule uses this at prefixes k=50,70. start_trial=1 so those prefixes include the block. Does not mix retrieve.

variants.label: P5+_A2_trial40_explore_exploit_50
variants.notes: A2 from trial 40 + 50/50 exploit(experience) vs explore(coverage_map).

variants.label: P5+_A5_trial40_explore_exploit_50
variants.notes: A5 from trial 40 + 50/50 exploit(experience) vs explore(coverage_map).

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_latch_X50
variants.notes: Part B: replace trial-50 clock with floor 24 + region-stability latch K=3; cap still 50. X50 explore/exploit keys off the same latch. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_bernstein_race_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + Bernstein/Hoeffding race on min-max rel_score (neither unless CIs separate). Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + keep only HPs with 1D bin-mean importance >= 0.10. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_full_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + official automl/fanova HP filter (thresh=0.10, 32 trees, min 24 trials) via dedicated venv. Falls back to sklearn RF then 1D proxy. Does not overwrite TRdyFanova.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_full_realcs_X50
variants.notes: 1+3: official fANOVA 1D main effects on the REAL ConfigSpace (types/bounds/log), keep top-k=4 or cumulative 0.60 (min 2 else unfiltered). Does not overwrite FanovaFull.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_full_interact_X50
variants.notes: 2+3: official fANOVA TOTAL importance (main+interactions) on the REAL ConfigSpace, same calibrated keep as FullCs. Does not overwrite FanovaFull or FullCs.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_rf_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + sklearn RF impurity importance HP filter (in-process, no extra env). Does not overwrite TRdyFanova.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_X50_surrogate_holdout
variants.notes: Kitchen-sink combo: A5 + Fanova readiness gate + X50 + RS surrogate retrieve. Pair with HPUCB_arm. Does not overwrite TRdyFanova or RS.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_fanova_X50_surrogate_until_self
variants.notes: Rectified combo: proxy Fanova + X50 + RS retrieve only until trial 50 (P5+ this-run start). Pair with HPUCB_arm_p05 (LLM ω 0.9→0.5). Does not overwrite TRdyFanovaX50RS or RSWarm.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_turbo_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + TuRBO L; tau_fail = max(4, n_hps) so GBM waits longer than CatBoost. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_ready_strength_X50
variants.notes: Part B: ready latch + piBO-style increasing language (hint / prefer / strongly prefer). Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_contrast_X50
variants.notes: Part B cheap fallback: insert when top-vs-bottom score gap >= 0.05*span after floor 24. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_stagnation_X50
variants.notes: Part B cheap fallback: insert when incumbent stagnates max(5, 0.15n) after floor 24. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_stagnation
variants.notes: Part C: p_explore = clip(stag/max(5,0.15n), 0.2, 0.8). Clock still 50. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_coverage
variants.notes: Part C: p_explore = clip(1-coverage/100, 0.2, 0.8). Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_intensify
variants.notes: Part C: SMAC intensify — exploit 3 LLM turns after an incumbent beat, else 50/50. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_refine
variants.notes: Part C: hard switch using existing explore_refine_summary rule (n<15 or stag>=8 or coverage<40). Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_hap
variants.notes: Part C: adaptive pursuit on (exploit, explore) prompt arms, P_min=0.2. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_dts
variants.notes: Part C: discounted Thompson on (exploit, explore) prompt arms. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_ucb
variants.notes: Part C: UCB on (exploit, explore) prompt arms, reward=incumbent beat. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_tpe_advisor
variants.notes: Part C: ghost TPE sample from the live study (ALL LLM+TPE trials). If that config sits in prefer regions → exploit, else explore. Does not overwrite X50. On 80-trial evals TPE is still messy; use P5plusA5T50XTPELate for high-budget runs.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_tpe_advisor_late
variants.notes: XTPE backup: XOR stays off (X50 coin-flip) until trial 200, then ghost-TPE hard XOR. For budgets >> 80. Does not overwrite XTPE. Not queued on the 80-trial suite.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_tpe_advisor_soft
variants.notes: Part C: p_explore = clip(1 - TPE-in-prefer-ratio, 0.2, 0.8) using TPE fit on ALL trials so far. Does not overwrite X50.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_tpe_advisor_llm_only
variants.notes: Part C: ghost TPE fit on LLM(+warm-start) trials only. If that sample sits in prefer regions → exploit, else explore. Does not overwrite XTPE.

variants.label: P5+_A5_T50_explore_tpe_advisor_llm_only_soft
variants.notes: Part C: p_explore = clip(1 - ratio, 0.2, 0.8) with TPE fit on LLM trials only. Does not overwrite XTPE.
